cifrado.explicacion: Choose a passphrase. It encrypts the journal and the therapy writing before they leave this computer: neither Supabase nor anyone else can read them.
cifrado.aviso: Keep it safe. There is no way to recover the content if you forget it: that is exactly the price of end-to-end encryption.
cifrado.introduce: Enter your passphrase to decrypt the journal and the therapy writing on this device.

ajustes.promptsAyuda: Choose which traditions the daily suggestion comes from. The prompt stays the same all day and is worked out offline.
ajustes.busquedaAyuda: {ctrl} + {k} opens the search box from any screen. It matches whole words across the journal, the documents, the character sheets and the therapy writing, ignoring case and accents. The index updates itself as you write; rebuilding it is only needed if you notice something missing.
ajustes.cifradoAyuda: The journal and the therapy writing are encrypted on this computer before they are uploaded. The novel and the essays travel in the clear so they can be searched on the server.
ajustes.tecladoAyuda: If you change the Windows keyboard layout while WriteFlow is open, the web engine the app runs on can keep the old one: you type in Spanish and get the English keys, with no accents. It's a known WebView2 bug — Microsoft's component — and there is nothing this app can do about it. Restarting always fixes it. Nothing is lost: your writing saves itself.
ajustes.supabaseAyuda: Paste your project's URL and public (anon) key here. In Supabase → Authentication → URL Configuration add {redirect} as a Redirect URL so the Google sign-in can come back to the app.
ajustes.terminaNavegador: Finish signing in in the browser; you'll come back here automatically.
ajustes.conflictosAyuda: You edited the same thing in two places. Nothing is lost: choose which version to keep.
ajustes.githubAyuda: Dumps all your work as Markdown files into a private repository, in a single commit. It's your archive: plain text you can read without this app. Create a token with {permiso} permission on that repository.
ajustes.incluirPrivado: Include the journal and the therapy writing too
ajustes.incluirPrivadoAviso: (in the clear: use a private repository)
clave.desajuste: This computer encrypts with a different key
clave.desajusteAyuda: The key doesn't come from your passphrase alone, but from the passphrase plus a random salt. This computer generated its own instead of using the one already in the cloud, so what you write here your other computers can't read, and what arrives from them shows up blank. Type the passphrase you used the first time and this computer will adopt the shared key. Your local text is left alone.
clave.adoptada: This computer now uses the same key as the others
clave.repararAyuda: Only needed if something arrived unreadable, or if two computers were encrypting with different keys. On the computer that still has the good text, upload it again: it is re-encrypted with the current key and overwrites the cloud copy. On the one with blank entries, download it again. Nothing on your computer is ever deleted.
clave.volverASubir: Upload everything from this computer again
clave.marcadas: {n} rows marked to be uploaded encrypted again
